title: Fix Desktop White Screen From Playwright Core Bundle Errors
description: Desktop shows white screen because playwright-core gets pulled into Vite client bundle, causing chromium-bidi resolution failures and infinite dep optimization loop crashing Electron with ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES
summary: Fixed desktop white screen caused by playwright-core being pulled into Vite dependency optimization. The desktop renderer vite config scans ../sketchpad/index.ts for dependencies, which imports @playwright/test. Vite dep optimizer tried to bundle playwright-core which failed on missing chromium-bidi, causing an infinite optimization loop crashing Electron with ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES. Added @playwright/test, playwright, and playwright-core to optimizeDeps.exclude in vite.renderer.config.ts.
